python -c "
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from semver import process, createparser
import argparse

# Test bump
args = argparse.Namespace(which='bump', bump='major', version='1.2.3')
result = process(args)
print('bump result:', result)

# Test compare
args = argparse.Namespace(which='compare', version1='1.2.3', version2='1.2.4')
result = process(args)
print('compare result:', result)

# Test check valid
args = argparse.Namespace(which='check', version='1.2.3')
try:
    result = process(args)
    print('check valid result:', result)
except Exception as e:
    print('check valid exception:', e)

# Test check invalid
args = argparse.Namespace(which='check', version='invalid')
try:
    result = process(args)
    print('check invalid result:', result)
except Exception as e:
    print('check invalid exception:', e)
"
